entry.name: Google AI Essentials
entry.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
entry.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

covers: Using AI tools to generate ideas and content
Using AI tools for research, organization, and decision-making
Creating text and image content with generative AI
Selecting the right AI tools for work needs
reading.format: Self-paced program with videos, readings, interactive exercises, and hands-on activities. A certificate is earned after completion.
reading.summary: Google AI Essentials is a self-paced program that helps people across roles and industries gain AI skills to boost productivity. It is taught by AI experts at Google and takes under 10 hours. Completing the program earns a certificate from Google.
reading.audience: People across roles and industries who are new to AI. Zero experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: Zero experience required. No programming skills needed.
